body.text: This pass made a number of changes to how the site handles metadata, indexing signals, and other things invisible to users, but visible to web crawlers. A few other fixes are included below:

texts: Added an attempt to fix an issue where the site's hosting service was too aggressively caching the homepage, causing it to show an outdated list of latest builds, md plans, and the showcase. This issue started in the last update.
Fixed base identity full art being broken.
Fixed a possible crash in the extraction simulator during loading.
